players.product: synthetic DNA, proteins, antibody libraries, and characterization data

quarterly_data.signal: Revenue reached $118.4 million, up 23%, for a fourteenth consecutive quarter of sequential growth. DNA synthesis and protein solutions revenue grew 39% to $56.6 million and the company shipped 369,000 genes.

Biopharma Solutions revenue grew 49% to $40.4 million, with management citing demand from pharma, dry-lab biotech, large technology companies and AI-enabled discovery customers. Orders from AI-enabled customers are expected to grow at a triple-digit rate in FY2026 and again in FY2027.
quarterly_data.figure: Biopharma Solutions $40.4M (+49%); AI-enabled orders expected triple-digit growth

quarterly_data.signal: Over three years, manufacturing cost declined 60%, waste fell 70%, turnaround time improved 73% and oligo capacity increased fourfold. Full-year revenue guidance was $456-$457 million, with adjusted EBITDA breakeven expected in the fourth quarter.
quarterly_data.figure: cost -60%; waste -70%; turnaround -73%; capacity 4x; FY revenue $456M-$457M
